item.title: Choose a Controller for Your Product Line
item.description:
The right controller is the one that matches your target platform, customer and retail positioning. These five models serve different briefs; use their product pages for the full configuration and confirm the selected version before listing or ordering.

G1, G2, G6 Pro and G7 support Switch 2, Switch, PC, mobile devices and Steam Deck. These four models connect to Steam Deck via Bluetooth. G1 and G2 also support waking the Switch 2 console.

item.title: Samples, Branding & Packaging: What to Confirm
item.description:
A useful first quotation starts with the exact model and the type of sample you need. Evaluation samples, unbranded samples and custom-branded production are different requests.

Ordering & Shipping FAQ

Small wholesale orders, custom branding and dropshipping are different services. Check the options below before requesting a quotation.

Can I start with 5 or 10 units?

Yes. Small wholesale orders of 5 or 10 units are welcome. These orders use the factory’s existing logo and factory-branded packaging, without custom branding. Confirm the model and current availability when requesting a quote.

item.title: Compare Switch 2 Grips
item.description:

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description:
Privacy Policy

Effective Date: October 19, 2026

int-rock (“we,” “us,” or “our”) is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you visit our website int-rock.com or contact us regarding our products and services.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

  • Contact Information: Name, email address, company name, and phone number when you submit a contact form or request a quote.
  • Communication Records: Contents of messages you send to us via email or contact forms.
  • Usage Data: If you allow optional analytics, we use Google Analytics 4 to measure page visits, product views, contact-link clicks and successfully submitted inquiries. Google Analytics may process device, browser, approximate location and cookie-based identifiers. We do not send inquiry names, email addresses, company names or message text as analytics event parameters.
  • Inquiry Sources: Contact forms can include campaign labels, the landing-page path and the referring website origin so we can understand which channels bring inquiries. These source details may be retained in browser session storage during your visit.

We do not collect payment information or sensitive personal data through this website.
